name: KH Neochem Co., Ltd.
summary: KH Neochem Co., Ltd. researches, manufactures, and sells of petrochemical products in Japan and internationally. The company provides basic chemicals, including butyl alcohol and acetate, 2-ethyl hexyl alcohol, isononyl alcohol, ethylene glycol monobutyl ether, methyl isobutyl ketone, butyl acetate, and diethylene glycol monobutyl and triethylene glycol monobutyl ether for use in paints, inks, thinners, cleaners, detergents, plasticizer raw materials, and resin raw materials. It also offers performance materials, such as 2-ethyl hexanoic and isononanoic acid, diacetone acrylamide, and 1,3-butylene glycol for use in lubricants, water-borne paints, and cosmetics.
